passage: I am Siddharth, and I still remember the recess when a girl from 5B leaned close and whispered that Pradeep thought I was boring now. She said it sweetly, as if she were doing me a favour. All afternoon my stomach felt tight, and I replayed every joke I had told that week. I nearly stopped sitting with him. Then I thought: she was not even there when he said it, if he said it at all. So the next morning I simply asked Pradeep, right at the bicycle stand. He looked confused and then laughed. "Boring? You lent me your cricket cards!" I felt silly and relieved together. The girl never whispered to me again.

qa.q: Where did Siddharth ask Pradeep about the boring remark?
qa.a: Siddharth asked him at the bicycle stand the next morning.

qa.q: Why did Siddharth's stomach feel tight, and why did Siddharth replay every joke after the whisper?
qa.a: Siddharth worried the girl's claim might be true, so Siddharth searched for a reason Pradeep might find the friendship boring.

qa.q: What could someone try when a rival whispers that a friend has turned against them?
qa.a: They can ask the friend directly, as Siddharth did, instead of taking the whisper as fact, since the whisperer may want to split them up.

qa.q: How might Pradeep have felt when Siddharth suddenly asked about the boring remark?
qa.a: Pradeep looked confused first, which suggests he had no idea anyone thought this, and then he laughed and reminded Siddharth about the cricket cards.

grounding: A whispering girl tries to split two friends and the narrator checks directly with the friend.

passage:
The shared jeep to Champhai school bumped along the hill road. Mawii slid next to Lalremsiami and whispered, "Chinmay told me you're boring now. That's why he sits with the Class 6 boys."
Lalremsiami's throat tightened. She stared out at the terraced fields. All morning she didn't look at Chinmay once.
But at lunch she remembered how Mawii had once tried to split two other friends. So she walked up to Chinmay at the water tap. "Did you say I'm boring?"
Chinmay's mouth fell open. "What? No! I sit with them because they're teaching me football. Come watch tomorrow."
Lalremsiami let out a long breath and grinned.

qa.q: Why did Chinmay say he sits with the Class 6 boys?
qa.a: Because they are teaching him football.

qa.q: What was Lalremsiami feeling after Mawii's whisper in the jeep?
qa.a: She felt hurt and anxious; her throat tightened and she avoided looking at Chinmay all morning.

qa.q: What did Lalremsiami do that was wise?
qa.a: She checked directly with Chinmay instead of trusting Mawii, which cleared up the lie in one question.

qa.q: How might Chinmay feel when he hears what Mawii said?
qa.a: Chinmay seems shocked and maybe a little hurt that his friend believed it, and quickly reassures her with an invitation.

grounding: A girl whispers that a child's best friend finds her boring, hoping to split them; the child checks directly with the friend instead of trusting the whisperer.

passage:
In the lunch queue at their Melbourne school, Chloe leaned in towards Tuan. "Lucia thinks you're so boring now. She told me she's sick of your robot talk."
Tuan's ears burned. He took his tray and sat at the far end of the table, away from Lucia. He barely ate.
Then he noticed Chloe smiling at him across the room, as if she were watching to see what he'd do. Something felt off.
After lunch, he found Lucia at the lockers. "Did you tell Chloe you're sick of me?"
Lucia frowned. "Never. I asked her if you'd finished the robot arm. She's been saying weird stuff about everyone."
Tuan's shoulders dropped. "Want to see it after school?"

qa.q: What had Lucia really asked Chloe about?
qa.a: Whether Tuan had finished the robot arm.

qa.q: What was Tuan feeling when he sat at the far end of the table?
qa.a: He felt hurt and embarrassed after Chloe's whisper; his ears burned and he barely ate.

qa.q: What made Tuan's next step a good one?
qa.a: He noticed Chloe watching for a reaction and asked Lucia directly, instead of letting the whisper decide the friendship.

qa.q: How might Lucia see Chloe's whispering?
qa.a: Lucia sees it as a pattern, saying Chloe has been saying weird stuff about everyone, so she is not surprised but annoyed.

grounding: A girl whispers that a boy's best friend finds him boring; he senses she wants to split them and checks directly with his friend.
